paper_metadata.title: Design and mechanical properties of easily castable refractory high entropy alloys

evidence.quote: Refractory high-entropy alloys (RHEAs) have attracted wide attention due to the simple body-centered cubic (BCC) solid solution structure and excellent mechanical properties at super-high temperature.
In this study, four RHEAs: Ti 30 Zr 40 Al 10 V 10 Nb 10 , Ti 40 Zr 40 Al 10 V 10 , Ti 40 Zr 40 Al 10 Nb 10 and Ti 40 Zr 40 V 10 Nb 10 with good castability were designed and successfully prepared.

EDS results listed in Table 3 reveal that the precipitates are rich in β-phase-stabilizing element V, suggesting that the precipitates possess a BCC structure, in agreement with the XRD results.
the light gray precipitates are identified as the AlZr2 phase (point3，4), while the dark gray precipitates are identified as V-rich β1 phase (point1，2), and point 5，6 is the matrix.
the long strip-shaped precipitates within the grain interior are also Al-rich HCP phases (Point 3), while the uniformly distributed fine granular precipitates are V-rich β1 phases (Point 4).
